title: Credit card sales call with a 'today only' offer

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello sir, I'm calling from Axis Bank cards. You are pre-approved for a lifetime free credit card.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sir, this offer is valid only today, and you also get airport lounge access.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you change your mind, apply on the Axis website or app. We never ask for card numbers or OTPs over the phone.
